summary: Stop the reconcile-only provider boundary check from failing on read-time derived source health fields (staleness_seconds) while preserving strict equality on all persisted source health fields.

incident_context.symptom: pantheon-source-ingest-scheduler-1 running restarts=0 health=unhealthy, logging 'ControllerTickError: reconcile-only tick mutated source_health for non-executed connector tw-twse-tpex-official-market' stage provider_boundary on ticks 6..10
incident_context.root_cause: Two GET /api/source-ingest/controller/readback calls 5s apart differ in source_health.staleness_seconds (tw-twse-tpex-official-market 186381 -> 186386) because staleness_seconds is dynamically computed at read time from freshness.staleness_seconds; the provider boundary check compared pre_c.get('source_health') != act_c.get('source_health') directly
incident_context.resolution: Define _SOURCE_HEALTH_DERIVED_FIELDS = frozenset({'staleness_seconds'}) and _persisted_source_health() helper next to the check in services/source_ingestion/controller_worker.py, ignoring read-time derived fields while strictly comparing all persisted source health fields (status, last_success_at, last_failure_at, updated_at, row and error counts, latest_source_record)

acceptance_verification.ac1_persisted_health_mutation_fails_deri: passed: _persisted_source_health strips _SOURCE_HEALTH_DERIVED_FIELDS ('staleness_seconds') before comparison, preserving checks on status, last_success_at, last_failure_at, updated_at, and counts
acceptance_verification.ac2_derived_exclusion_defined_once_next_: passed: _SOURCE_HEALTH_DERIVED_FIELDS = frozenset({'staleness_seconds'}) defined once directly preceding _validate_due_state_readback in services/source_ingestion/controller_worker.py
acceptance_verification.ac3_test_staleness_drift_succeeds_last_f: passed: test_due_state_readback_accepts_staleness_seconds_drift_for_non_executed_connector, test_due_state_readback_rejects_mutating_non_executed_connector_last_failure_at, and matching run_controller_tick tests pass
